_comment: Sạp Tạp Hóa of Bà Chủ Sạp in Trúc Lâm Thôn (spec 12.4): basic goods with a daily limit per player, Phàm/Linh equipment, and buying back. Every buy price is above anything the same thing sells for anywhere (tests/test_economy.py checks there is no buy-low-sell-high loop). hat_giong_thuong is a random common seed of the player's tier and counts toward the 15 new seeds a day. reach: how close to Bà Chủ Sạp (pixels). gift: presents between friends (unbound items only).
seed_desc_vi: Một hạt chữ Thường ngẫu nhiên (ưu tiên chữ con chưa có). Tính vào 15 hạt mới mỗi ngày.
